title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha shares concerns with Pallavan about the truth surrounding his mother. Pallavan becomes upset as the conversation revives painful memories of his mother's abandonment.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar excitedly tells Bagyaraj about the movie outing and invites Revathi, who declines joining the family. Meanwhile, Selvi complains to Malar and Lakshmi about stacked dishes.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 65: The Fall of Junior BB?
description: A fake fight assigned by Junior BB to Mukesh and Danya sparks genuine concern before triggering house outrage. Later, furious housemates unite to strip Vinoth of his power.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Eshwari and Chithra ask their lawyer to meet Savithri to uncover Aishwarya's deceit. Meanwhile, Aishwarya panics when Sethupathi catches her mimicking Tamizhselvi's voice.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu proposes to Arjun, who gives her a ring. Meanwhile, Sankar confronts Aadhavan and Pooja with proof of their romance, questioning their trust.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu takes a sad Kanmani to Kaveri's house to cheer her up. Kanmani finds joy eating Sarasu's mangoes, while Anbu learns how to tie a garland from Kaveri.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Azhagappan feigns illness to win over Abhi and Shanmugam, targeting Kandhasamy's land. Indhira suspects his motives, while his men applaud his ongoing drama.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: On their wedding night, Pandian asks Gomathi if he took good care of her, but she shocks him with a list of complaints. Meanwhile, Kathir and Raji share a romantic moment.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Chandra regrets failing to care for Meena during her pregnancy after meeting her at the temple. Later, Shruthi stuns the family when they question her decision about the baby.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: The family joyfully celebrates Abinaya's academic success by cutting a cake. Vetri then defeats her in a chess challenge and demands that she follow his orders for a day.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Senthamizh refuses to marry when Manjamalai suggests an alliance, and he respects her choice. Azhagar rejects Poongodi's cooking and prepares an omelette with unusual spices.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
episodeTitle: Ilamathi Vows to Uncover the Truth
description: Ilamathi challenges Kalamma, vowing to prove her involvement in Ashok's murder. Later, she informs Paraman about Ayyappan staying at Rishi's house after spotting his photo.
